newsitem.title: USA: Imation launches stock sale/purchase plan.
newsitem.headline: Imation launches stock sale/purchase plan.

text.p: Imation Corp said Thursday it launched a voluntary odd-lot share selling/purchasing program for shareholders with fewer than 100 shares.
The company said it retained Shareholder Communications Corp to manage the program, which is tentatively set to expire on November 4.
The program lets Imation shareholders with fewer than 100 shares as of September 16 either purchase enough to reach 100 or sell all of their shares.

Shareholders who participate will pay or receive a price per share equal to the average closing market price while the program is in effect. The company said a processing fee of $0.90 a share will be charged.
Most Imation shareholders owning fewer than 100 shares received them after the July spin off from Minnesota Mining & Manufacturing Co.
Imation provides products and services for the information processing industry.
